test_case: The native launcher exposes its target selector and refresh command. Verify initial discovery with known running fixture processes. The three named examples belong to the prototype.
PID, process and title sorting exist. Exercise a PID query, runtime filter, empty result and reset together.
A tester attached the installed host to a controlled target. Verify the progress indication and initial selection in the three-pane workbench.
Use a permission-denied fixture. Verify actionable failure, retry and that the previous target is cleared.
Controlled detach and per-object edit isolation have separate evidence. Verify returning to the picker invalidates old references and edit history while retaining appearance and language.
Exit the target with a connected client. Check target-exit feedback, continued server availability and revoked target permissions.
Restart a fixture as a new process instance with the same simulated PID. Check that neither history nor grants transfer.
Switch a fixture among visual, logical and automation trees. Check the expected children and selection for each mode.
The smoke expands an 18-level tree and reads its leaf. Add a collapse assertion proving the child disappears and reappears on expansion.
VerifySearchRecovery searches by name and type, exercises no matches, then restores the selected tree row and property target.
Pick a projected element and select a tree item. The linked smoke cases check tree selection, path, highlight, property target and status.
Pointer picking selects the projected element. Verify F6 feedback and that a keyboard user can reach and pick a preview element.
Search for Width on the fixture button and compare the realized property names against the matching subset.
Combine Binding, Local and edited-only filters, then sort by source and check displayed rows after live changes.
Commit 完成 to SaveButton.Content. Check the property cell, the visible edited marker, the target text and changed pixels in the live preview.
After editing Button.Content, undo and redo across node reselection. Check both the value and history.
Reject negative Width and unparseable text. Check localized feedback, edit history, binding survival, correction and identical preview pixels for the rejected change.
Attempt to change ActualWidth through the selected editor. Check the read-only value, unchanged edit history and the bilingual explanation shown on screen and through UI Automation.
Open the Command binding source on SaveButton and check its path, resolved source and runtime status.
Existing trigger and event views have native UI. Switch binding, trigger and event views for populated and empty targets and check their contents.
Switch the dock tabs, filter their entries and clear recorded events and trace output.
Create a broken NameInput.ToolTip binding, inspect its diagnostic details and invoke Locate to select that element.
Use the navigation rail to reach diagnostics and events, inspect the selected dock tab and return with the selection intact.
Collapse and restore the tree, property and diagnostics panes and check visibility, state and splitter sizes.
Move splitters, resize, apply presets and reset. Check pane bounds and the layout after settings reload.
Ctrl+K, localized search, Enter and Escape are tested for workbench commands. Add coverage for the specified MCP and Settings destinations when available.
The native preview opens an explicit screenshot dialog. Verify that previewing or cancelling creates no file and document the difference from simulated capture feedback.
Open the MCP dashboard with the service stopped. Check the displayed loopback endpoint and that opening the page starts no listener.
Start the service and exercise permitted process, tree and element reads. Check the running state and per-call audit records.
Request a property write in default read-only mode. Assert refusal, unchanged data and a matching audit entry.
Enable write requests, inspect the displayed caller, target and parameters, then deny. Assert unchanged data and a denial record.
Allow one write, undo it and repeat the request. Check the undo record, audit and second prompt.
Allow a session grant and repeat an in-scope write. Check that each call is audited and no additional prompt appears.
Change the client, target instance or tool, then revoke the grant. Verify each out-of-scope or revoked write requires new consent.
Exercise both consent outcomes for a client attach request. Verify target and audit state after each choice.
Disconnect the target or stop the service during a pending write. Check the stale reference is rejected and the replacement target is untouched.
Make service startup fail, inspect the error and retry. Verify the displayed lifecycle states through stop.
Issue a second request during a pending consent prompt. Verify the original prompt remains and the second request is denied and audited.
Submit read, write and attach requests from an unknown or disconnected client. Verify refusal and audit with no consent dialog or target mutation.
Exercise language, palette and density changes on a selected element. Complete the combined edited-property and live MCP state check when that service exists.
Native tests cover bilingual property sources, readable controls and tree searches. Check SaveButton, ActualWidth and Binding together in both languages.
Reset demo data after changing a sample value and a preference. Verify sample values and history reset while the preference survives. This control belongs to the simulated data set.
